preConditions.onFailMessage: Duplicate COURSE_STAFF rows have the same COURSE_ID and EMAIL. No staff records were changed. Review their user and GitHub associations using docs/README_Course_Staff_Uniqueness.md, resolve each duplicate group, and restart to retry this migration.

sqlCheck.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT COURSE_ID, EMAIL FROM COURSE_STAFF WHERE COURSE_ID IS NOT NULL AND EMAIL IS NOT NULL GROUP BY COURSE_ID, EMAIL HAVING COUNT(*) > 1) duplicate_staff
